Lady Shri Ram College Closes Campus After Gangrape Allegations

Lady Shri Ram College for Women in Delhi has suspended in-person classes and will move to online learning following allegations of a gangrape. Students were scheduled to protest on the day the college announced the closure. The college has stopped students from entering the campus.
